typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight tracking for large headings. Use wide tracking for small overlines/labels. Embrace 'Swiss Brutalist' clarity for automotive details.

colors.rules: Rely on high contrast. The UI should be predominantly monochrome (black, white, cold grays) with the accent color (Emerald Green #10B981) used strictly for primary call-to-actions, successful states, and pricing highlights to evoke trust. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast minimum for text.

layouts.marketplace: Bento-grid inspired inventory cards. 1px subtle borders. Wide padding on containers (p-8 to p-12). Left-align data for easy scanning.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid layout. Sidebar navigation. Tables with tight padding, flat rectangular cards, subtle 1px border. No floating soft shadows here.
layouts.car_detail: Editorial style layout. Large immersive multi-image grid gallery at the top (e.g. 1 hero image left, 2 stacked right). Sticky specs and contact column on desktop.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism Crisp' – sharp 1px borders (border-black/5) with subtle drop shadows (shadow-sm) on white cards. Never apply one style globally.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky navigation or filter bars, use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a 1px border-b border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase (shadow-md) on hover. Buttons should dim or change text color explicitly.

components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-lg) for a modern, trustworthy feel. Active states must be visibly differentiated.
components.cards: Subtle border (border-zinc-200), white background, zero to minimal shadow until hovered.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but customize via Tailwind: rounded-md, bg-white, border-zinc-200. Focus ring must be the primary color (#0A0A0A).
components.car_gallery: Simple CSS Grid for images. First image spans 2 columns/2 rows, next 2 images span 1 column/1 row.
components.multi_photo_upload: Admin image upload needs visual grid for previews, drag-and-drop indicator, and individual 'remove' buttons per thumbnail.

motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion for soft fade-ins and staggered list reveal for car listing grids.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth transition (duration-200 ease-out) on all interactive elements. Avoid 'transition-all'.

accessibility: Ensure high contrast. Use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='filter-button'). Provide aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Do not rely solely on color to convey state changes.
instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize building the public UI with custom HTML/Tailwind for artistic control, using Shadcn JS selectively for interactive logic (Modals, Dropdowns).
For the Admin dashboard, leverage Shadcn components heavily to maintain a dense, data-rich, and functional aesthetic.
Implement a robust multi-image grid on the Car Details page. Do not just use a carousel; prioritize the grid view.
Admin upload component must visually support previewing multiple selected photos with a simple reorder or delete option.
Use standard fetch API or Axios for API integration. The backend is FastAPI and MongoDB.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
